how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-deeprun-tram-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6661:obj:0: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the ⟦E1⟧. Lead the rats back to ⟦E2⟧. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.
rows.quest:6661:details:0: Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.
rows.quest:6661:details:1: What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!
rows.quest:6661:details:2: Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.
rows.quest:6661:progress:0: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
rows.quest:6661:completion:0: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.
rows.quest:6662:obj:0: Take the ⟦E3⟧ to ⟦E4⟧ at the ⟦E5⟧ ⟦E6⟧ Depot.
rows.quest:6662:details:0: Me brother, ⟦E4⟧, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!
rows.quest:6662:details:1: Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
rows.quest:6662:progress:0: <⟦E4⟧ puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>⟦1⟧⟦2⟧Alive and kicking... and just in time!
rows.quest:6662:completion:0: Poor ⟦E2⟧. Ever since the ⟦E7⟧ incident, he hasn't been the same. That boy has never seen an ocean in his life, let alone being some kind of pirate.
rows.quest:6662:completion:2: At least he keeps the flow of twitching critters coming.
